reasoning: The September meeting only signaled that 'a moderation in the pace of asset purchases may soon be warranted,' while the November meeting actually initiates the taper, specifying concrete monthly reductions ($10B Treasuries, $5B MBS) and indicating similar reductions will likely continue each month. This marks the formal end of the QE-expansion regime and the start of the tapering regime — a transition in the dominant policy tool's trajectory from full accommodation to withdrawal of accommodation.
key_quote: the Committee decided to begin reducing the monthly pace of its net asset purchases by $10 billion for Treasury securities and $5 billion for agency mortgage-backed securities
